The provided evidence describes a review paper outlining the strengths and limitations of conventional strategies and novel methods (specifically microfluidic methods) for EV isolation, discussing commercially available isolation techniques/kits, and assessing global market demand. 

The candidate hypothesis proposes an empirical/experimental system integrating real-time adaptive machine learning (CNN), surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi), and size-exclusion chromatography (SEC) for exosome isolation and characterization. This specific methodology and hypothesis are neither proposed nor evaluated as the study's hypothesis in the provided abstract.

VERDICT: REJECT
